title: McLaren Senna in the Night Studio Above the City
label: MIDNIGHT GARAGE
statement: Inch by inch, it adds up.
description:
Welcome to the quiet warmth of the Night Studio, where a gunmetal grey McLaren Senna rests under the low glow of screens. Far below your window, the city glitters through the dark, keeping you company in the stillness. Two hours of music-only, mellow lo-fi hip hop fill the room with jazzy keys and a soft head-nod beat. It is a peaceful sanctuary carved out for you, perfect for working, studying, or simply relaxing.

No talking. No lyrics. No sudden sounds. Every track is original, made for CEO Focus.

CEO Focus | Dream Cars. Easy Listening.
